FX-PMAP-001.says: Persistent, red to Opacity 0 to 1: the still grid fades in from left to right.

FX-PMAP-002.says: Persistent, red to Scale 0.5 to 2: the grid's dots grow from left to right.

FX-PMAP-003.says: Persistent, green to Red and blue to Blue: the yellow dots turn mint green, less red in the top row than the bottom, with the ramp's middle blue.

FX-PMAP-004.says: Persistent, red to X 2.3 to 13.9: each fountain dot is pulled across to the place the ramp names under it, at every quarter frame.

FX-PMAP-005.says: Persistent, green to Y Velocity -40 to 10: dots low on the ramp shot up, high ones slowed; the speed kept after they leave.

FX-PMAP-006.says: Persistent, red to X Force -40 to 40: dots on the left pushed left, on the right pushed right, and kept pushed.

FX-PMAP-007.says: Persistent for the Cannon only, red to Opacity: the grid stays solid, the fountain's dots fade by place.

FX-PMAP-008.says: Persistent through the selection map: only the left half's dots take Scale 0.3.

FX-PMAP-009.says: Persistent only for dots older than about half a second (0.51), red to Opacity: young dots solid, older ones faded by where they were.

FX-PMAP-010.says: Persistent from the late layer (begins at frame 4) at frame 2: its map is clear, every channel 0, so Scale is its Min, 0.4, everywhere.

FX-PMAP-011.says: Persistent, red to Angle 0 to 90 on the exploded holder: each piece turned by where it was.

FX-PMAP-012.says: Persistent, red to Scale 0.5 to 1.5 on the Layer Map: each grid point the logo, smaller on the left.

FX-PMAP-013.says: Fireworks, the shells coloured persistently by the ramp (green to Green 0 to 1): each burst's sparks keep their shell's colour.

FX-PMAP-014.says: Persistent and the same property twice: red to Opacity, then green to Opacity 0.2 to 0.6; the green one wins, the grid fading by row.

FX-PMAP-015.says: Persistent with every channel on None: the fountain as without it.

FX-PMAP-016.says: Persistent, Max Red keyed 0 to 1 over frames 0 to 24, red to Opacity: the fountain's dots fainter the earlier they were mapped.

FX-PMAP-017.says: Ephemeral Set, red to Opacity: the fountain's dots fade by where they are now.

FX-PMAP-018.says: Ephemeral Add, green to Scale 0 to 1: dots bigger lower down.

FX-PMAP-019.says: Ephemeral Difference, red to Opacity: |1 - red|, the dots fading to the right.

FX-PMAP-020.says: Ephemeral Subtract, red to Scale 0 to 0.8: dots smaller to the right.

FX-PMAP-021.says: Ephemeral Multiply, green to Opacity: the grid's top row fainter than its bottom.

FX-PMAP-022.says: Ephemeral Min, red to Opacity 0.3 to 1: no dot more opaque than the ramp says.

FX-PMAP-023.says: Ephemeral Max, red to Scale 0 to 2: dots on the right grown, those on the left kept at 1.

FX-PMAP-024.says: Ephemeral Add, red to X -2 to 2: each dot drawn moved by the ramp, its path unchanged.

FX-PMAP-025.says: Ephemeral Add, red to X Velocity -30 to 30: each step pushed by the ramp under it, the push not kept.

FX-PMAP-026.says: Ephemeral Set, green to Y Force -60 to 60: dots high up pulled up, low ones down, only while there.

FX-PMAP-027.says: Ephemeral Add, red to Angle 0 to 45 on the exploded holder with Auto-Orient: each piece turned a little more to the right.

FX-PMAP-028.says: Ephemeral through the selection map, Scale 2: only dots over its white left half drawn twice the size.

FX-PMAP-029.says: Ephemeral only for dots younger than about half a second (0.51), blue to Green 1: the young red dots yellow.

FX-PMAP-030.says: Both: Persistent red to Opacity 0.3 to 1, then Ephemeral Multiply green to Opacity.

FX-PMAP-032.says: The wall with Ephemeral Add, red to X Velocity -20 to 20: the dots still bounce inside the box.

FX-PMAP-033.says: Fireworks with Ephemeral Set, red to Red 0 to 1, for the Particle Exploder's sparks only.

FX-PMAP-034.says: Persistent Map Layer naming a layer that is not in the composition: no mapping, the grid drawn as without it, and EFFECT_LAYER_MISSING.

FX-PMAP-035.says: Ephemeral Selection Map naming a missing layer: the mapper applies to every dot, and EFFECT_LAYER_MISSING.

FX-PMAP-036.says: Persistent Min Red -10001, below -10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMAP-037.says: Ephemeral Max Blue 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMAP-038.says: Persistent Age Feather -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMAP-039.says: Persistent Map Red To "mass", not built. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMAP-040.says: Ephemeral Operator "divide". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMAP-041.says: Ephemeral Particles From "everything". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMAP-042.says: A Persistent Map Layer written as the number 3, not a word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PMAP-043.says: Ephemeral Max Green keyed to 20000 at frame 4, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
